_comment: Shared verifier/allowlist config used by ALL providers. The 3 allowed URLs are the full (provider, symbol)-bearing URLs the deployed QuoteVerifier accepts. URL matching is *not* in the lib -- the deploy script Poseidon2-hashes each URL (zero-padded to MAX_URL_LEN) and the contract stores those hashes in a Map<Field, PublicImmutable<bool>>. verify() hashes envelope.request_url with the same zero-padding and reads the map slot; an uninitialized read reverts. Exact byte equality is structural: different URL bytes -> different hash -> not in map.
